confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from web search results summarizing aggregated Lima cost-of-living and menu-price guides. The sources disagree, some pages are dated well before July 2026, and their dollar conversions are inconsistent, so local prices were converted at an approximate sol-dollar level, which is itself uncertain. Restaurant meals and coffee are the most consistent across sources. The cocktail anchor rests on mixed venue and guide data. The wine-by-the-glass anchor was set from glass-price data and cross-checked against the beer anchor (roughly twice a domestic draft) because glass-price data were thin. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings, and July tourist demand could push them higher.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors rest on Lima's own aggregated price data. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates positioned against Lima's hostel and mid-market hotel supply rather than a named comparable city.
